questions.statement: Last year, my family ________ to San Andrés for our vacation.
questions.context: Identifying a completed action in the past.

options.feedback: Incorrect. We need the past form for "last year".
Correct! "Went" is the irregular past of "go".
Incorrect. This is present tense.
Incorrect. We use Past Simple for completed actions at a specific time.

questions.explanation:
El Pasado Simple se utiliza para acciones que comenzaron y terminaron en un momento específico del pasado (como "last year").

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: I ________ my homework yesterday because I was feeling sick.
questions.context: Forming a negative sentence in the past.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Negative past needs "didn't" + base form.
Incorrect. After "didn't", we use the base form, not the past form.
Correct! "Didn't" + base form is the correct negative structure.
Incorrect. This is present tense, but the context is "yesterday".

questions.explanation:
Para formar oraciones negativas en el Pasado Simple, usamos el auxiliar "didn't" (did not) seguido del verbo en su forma base.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: At 8:00 PM last night, I ________ a movie on TV.
questions.context: Describing an action in progress in the past.

options.feedback: Incorrect. This would be a completed action, but the specific time implies progress.
Correct! Past Continuous describes an action in progress at a specific past moment.
Incorrect. This is present tense.
Incorrect. "I" takes "was", not "were".

questions.explanation:
El Pasado Continuo (was/were + -ing) se usa para describir acciones que estaban ocurriendo en un momento específico del pasado.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: We ________ soccer in the park when it suddenly started to rain.

options.feedback: Incorrect. "Played" implies a completed action, but the context shows an interruption.
Correct! The action in progress (playing) is interrupted by another action (raining).
Incorrect. This is present, but the context is past.
Incorrect. "We" is plural and requires "were".

questions.explanation:
Cuando una acción prolongada en el pasado (Pasado Continuo) es interrumpida por otra acción corta (Pasado Simple), usamos "when" para conectarlas.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: ________ you ________ to the concert in Bogotá last weekend?

options.feedback: Correct! "Did" + base form is the correct structure for past questions.
Incorrect. "Were" is not used with base verbs in questions.
Incorrect. After "did", we must use the base form "go".
Incorrect. This is present, but the context is "last weekend".

questions.explanation:
Las preguntas en el Pasado Simple comienzan con el auxiliar "Did", seguido del sujeto y el verbo en su forma base.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: In 1819, the Battle of Boyacá ________ a turning point for Colombia's independence.

options.feedback: Incorrect. This is a historical event in the past.
Correct! "Was" is the past of "is" for singular subjects.
Incorrect. "The Battle" is singular.
Incorrect. "Been" is a past participle and needs an auxiliary.

questions.explanation:
Para hechos históricos o biografías, usamos el Pasado Simple. "Was" y "were" son las formas pasadas del verbo "to be".

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: While my mother ________ dinner, my father ________ the table.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Usually, "while" suggests two continuous actions.
Correct! Both actions were happening at the same time.
Incorrect. This is present, but the context is past.
Incorrect. Present Continuous in a past context.

questions.explanation:
Usamos el Pasado Continuo en ambas partes de la oración cuando dos acciones estaban ocurriendo simultáneamente en el pasado, usualmente conectadas por "while".

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
"The sun **was shining** (1) and the birds **were singing** (2) when Gabriel **decided** (3) to go for a walk."

Which verbs represent the background atmosphere?
questions.context: Distinguishing between background information and main events.

options.feedback: Correct! Past Continuous sets the scene or background.
Incorrect. Decided is the main action that happened.
Incorrect. Decided is not part of the background atmosphere.
Incorrect. There is a clear distinction between background and main action.

questions.explanation:
En la narración, el Pasado Continuo se utiliza para "pintar el escenario" (la atmósfera de fondo), mientras que el Pasado Simple se usa para las acciones principales que ocurren.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence describes actions that happened one after another (a sequence)?
questions.context: Identifying the correct sequence of events.

options.text: I was eating when the phone rang.
options.feedback: Incorrect. This is an interruption, not a sequence.

options.text: I got up, brushed my teeth, and had breakfast.
options.feedback: Correct! These are sequential actions in the past.

options.text: While I was studying, she was sleeping.
options.feedback: Incorrect. These are simultaneous actions.

options.text: I was having a dream about flying.
options.feedback: Incorrect. This is a single continuous state.

questions.explanation:
Para narrar una serie de acciones cortas que ocurrieron una tras otra en el pasado, usamos una lista de verbos en Pasado Simple.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the sentence that is grammatically perfect:
questions.context: Correcting errors in a complex narrative paragraph.

options.text: I was seeing a strange light while I walked home last night.
options.feedback: Incorrect. "See" is a stative verb; it should be "I saw".

options.text: When the teacher was arriving, all students were sitting down.
options.feedback: Incorrect. The arrival should be a point in time (Past Simple).

options.text: I was reading a book when I suddenly realized I was in the wrong room.
options.feedback: Correct! Uses continuous for background and simple for the sudden event.

options.text: She was cryed because she was losing her favorite toy.
options.feedback: Incorrect. "Cryed" is misspelled and "was losing" sounds awkward here.

questions.explanation:
Este nivel requiere evaluar el uso correcto de verbos de estado (stative verbs) y la lógica de la interrupción en narrativas complejas.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which apology sounds more sincere and professional for a past mistake?
questions.context: Evaluating the tone of a past apology.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Too informal.

options.text: I sincerely apologize for the delay; I was experiencing some technical issues yesterday.
options.feedback: Correct! Formal, clear, and uses Past Continuous to explain context.

options.text: I didn't did it on purpose, so don't be mad.
options.feedback: Incorrect. Grammatically wrong and too informal.

options.text: I am sorry I am not doing the work last week.
options.feedback: Incorrect. Uses present continuous for a past event.

questions.explanation:
En el nivel B1, se espera que el estudiante pueda elegir el tono adecuado (formal/informal) y usar estructuras gramaticales precisas para justificar acciones pasadas.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: "We were hiking through the Cocora Valley when the fog became extremely thick. We couldn't see anything, so we..."
questions.context: Completing a story with the most logical and grammatically correct ending.

options.text: decided to stop and wait until it cleared up.
options.feedback: Correct! Logical decision in Past Simple following a background situation.

options.text: are deciding to run back to the town quickly.
options.feedback: Incorrect. Changes to present tense in a past narrative.

options.text: were decided to take some beautiful photos.
options.feedback: Incorrect. Grammatically incorrect (were decided).

options.text: will wait for a miracle to happen soon.
options.feedback: Incorrect. Future tense doesn't fit the past narrative.

questions.explanation: Completar una historia requiere mantener la consistencia del tiempo verbal (Pasado Simple para la decisión) y la coherencia lógica con el contexto proporcionado.
